observation: Original's page title is only the brand name 'AEP Texas'; the AI-built page's title adds the tagline: 'AEP Texas | Knowledge is power.'
Both documents declare lang='en' and include no JSON-LD structured data blocks.

The original has few semantic landmarks: one nav and one footer, with no header, main, section or article, inside 638 divs. The AI-built page uses one header, one nav, one main, four sections, five articles and one footer, with 33 divs.

Both pages have exactly one h1. The original's outline is irregular: it starts with a hidden h2 'Processing your request', has 30 h6 elements, and includes hidden modal headings such as 'Loading video...' and privacy-policy h4s. The AI-built outline runs cleanly from h1 to five h2s, five h3s and four h4s, with no skipped levels.

The original has a login form, but it sits in hidden markup with 9 inputs and 9 buttons and is not visible. The AI-built page shows the login form inside the hero as a visible white rounded card with a soft shadow. The card has the h2 'Welcome back!', two labeled inputs, a remember checkbox, a full-width blue 'Log in' button and three underlined links.
The original loads 26 scripts, 4 stylesheets, an iframe and tracking pixels. The AI-built page loads no scripts and no external stylesheets, and uses a single inline <style> block.
The original uses legacy or non-standard elements: 9 nobr, 1 noindexfb and 11 hr.

The original sets all 1,382 counted elements in the web font din-2014, a condensed DIN-style sans with an Arial/Roboto fallback. The AI-built page uses a system-ui font stack on 154 elements and Arial on one element, and loads no web font.
On both pages the h1 is the brand slogan 'Knowledge is power.', bold (700) and left-aligned in the hero, rather than a descriptive headline.
The original's h1 is 66px, uppercase ('KNOWLEDGE IS POWER.') and brick red rgb(175,34,24), set over a photo. The AI-built h1 is 57.6px, sentence case and white, set over a dark-blue gradient.
The original's body text is 20px with a 30px line height. The AI-built page's body text is 16px with a 25.6px line height.

The original sets many headings and labels in uppercase bold: nav labels, quick-link tiles, 'BRING HOME ENERGY SAVINGS', 'SOLUTIONS FOR YOUR BUSINESS' and 'GET REVVED UP FOR ELECTRIC CARS'. The AI-built page uses sentence case and Title Case throughout, for example 'Home energy savings and rebates' and 'Get Revved up for Electric Cars'.
The original's section h2s are 32px and often red. The AI-built page's h2s are 20.8px by computed style and use navy rgb(11,42,74), with slate-grey rgb(90,103,117) lead paragraphs below them.
Both pages give the lower content cards bold Title Case h3 titles, for example 'View Your Meter Order Status' and 'Confused About Outages?'.

The original's main brand accent is red rgb(218,41,28): it appears on the login button, the hero h1, the rule under the header, the band above the footer, the play-arrow icons and the privacy link. The AI-built page's main accent is blue rgb(0,91,159), with navy rgb(11,42,74) and rgb(7,25,44), a pale blue tint and a single amber accent rgb(242,169,0). Red does not appear.
Both pages use white rgb(255,255,255) as the body and dominant background.

The original's body text is gray rgb(74,74,74), and its secondary bands are light gray rgb(243,243,243). The AI-built page's body text is navy-black rgb(28,39,51), and its secondary fills are pale blue and dark navy instead of gray.
The original's inline links are blue rgb(0,120,170). The AI-built page underlines its links and colors them by context: white on navy and blue in the login card. Its nav links are not underlined.

The original uses colored icons: blue, orange, teal and green circular outline icons on the quick links, a green lightbulb and an orange lightning bolt. The AI-built page has no icons; it uses text arrow glyphs (→) and photographs.

The original's top utility bar is thin light gray and holds only a right-aligned globe 'ESPAÑOL' link. The AI-built page's utility strip is dark navy, with Visit AEP.com, Investors and Careers on the left and Español plus the phone number on the right.
On both pages the header is a white bar with the AEP Texas logo at the left and five primary nav links at the right.
In the original, a thick red rule runs under the main header.

The original's nav links are uppercase and are followed by a solid red 'LOG IN' button and a search magnifier icon. The AI-built nav has five plain-text links with no login button or search icon in the header.

The original's primary button is red rgb(218,41,28) with an 8px radius, padding 0 27px and the uppercase label 'LOG IN'. The AI-built primary button is blue rgb(0,91,159) with a 6px radius, padding 12px 22px and the label 'Log in'.

The original's hero is a full-bleed photo of a smiling woman on a phone, with a light wash on the left behind left-aligned text. It has no CSS gradient. The AI-built hero is a CSS dark-blue diagonal gradient band with no photo, split into two columns: headline, alert and quick links on the left, and the login card on the right.

Both pages put a pandemic scam-awareness message right under the h1. In the original it is plain hero subcopy ending in a red arrow icon. In the AI-built page it sits in a translucent white-tinted box with an amber left border and a bold underlined link.

The original's quick links are four tiles in a semi-transparent white strip below the hero. Each pairs a circular icon with a two-line uppercase label, and vertical dividers separate them. The AI-built quick links are a 2x2 grid of equal 279x54 white buttons inside the dark hero, with bold navy labels and blue → arrows.

The original's energy-savings block is a two-column split. The left column has a red h2, a paragraph and an outlined 'Learn about incentives' button. The right column has a centered green lightbulb, a bold line and an outlined 'See how' button. The AI-built version puts a photo on the left and text on the right, with a solid blue 'Learn about incentives' button. Below that is a 'Tip:' callout with an amber left border and an outlined 'See how' button.

The original's call-to-action buttons are mostly outlined: thin dark border, white fill, light dark text and a small radius. The AI-built page's call-to-action buttons are mostly solid blue with white bold text, about 50px tall; the only outlined one is 'See how'.

Both pages use little corner rounding and no pills or radii of 16px or more. The original has 1,346 elements at 0, 35 at 1–7px and only 1 at 8–15px. The AI-built page has 124 at 0, 18 at 1–7px and 13 at 8–15px, used on cards and images.
The original has no box shadows and no gradients. The AI-built page has 3 box shadows, on the login card and the feature images, and 1 gradient, on the hero.
Neither page uses animations, transforms or backdrop blur.
The original has 291 CSS transitions; the AI-built page has 4.
The original lays out with flexbox only: 235 flex containers and no grid. The AI-built page mixes 7 grid and 15 flex containers.
The original's content column is about 1300px wide (x=70 to 1370 on a 1440px viewport). The AI-built page's column is 1080px wide (x=180 to 1260).

In the original, the EV section is a full-content-width 1300x449 banner: white uppercase text sits on a slate-blue tint over the charger photo. In the AI-built page, the EV section is a two-column row on a pale blue rgb(232,241,249) band, with text on the left and a 516x178 image on the right, which reverses the savings row above it.

In the original, 'Solutions for your business' and 'Are you new to AEP Texas' are two half-width photo cards with text overlaid on the photos, each ending in a red play-arrow icon. In the AI-built page, they are bordered <article> cards inside a three-column 'Services for you' grid, with the photo above the text and a solid blue button.
The original uses a red circular play-arrow icon as an inline link affordance after the hero copy, the EV banner and the promo cards.

In the original, the outage-alert section is a left-aligned horizontal strip between thick light-gray bands. It has an orange lightning icon, an orange heading, gray copy and an outlined 'Sign up today' button on the right. In the AI-built page, it is a full-width navy band with a centered white h2 and paragraph and an amber-filled 'Sign up today' button with dark text.

In the original, the meter-status, outages and community items form one three-column row of equal 393x278 photos, each followed by an h3, a paragraph and an outlined button. In the AI-built page, meter status sits in the three-column services grid (342x228 photos, bordered rounded cards of equal height). Outages and community form a separate two-column row with larger 526x351 images.

Both pages use raster stock-style photos of real people and places, including a utility worker, a house under a stormy sky, people on laptops and phones, and an EV charger. Both use an SVG logo and no inline SVGs.
On the AI-built page, the feature images are wide, short crops (516x149 and 516x178) with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow. The phone image is washed out on its left half.

The original's content photos have empty alt text, and one image has no alt attribute. Only the logo and the loader have descriptive alt. All 8 images on the AI-built page have descriptive alt text, and none is missing.
Above the original's footer, a full-width solid red band holds four centered bold uppercase white links: Safety, Company, Clean Energy and Business.

The original's footer sits on white. It leads with the large phrase 'Need help? Call us.' and an outlined 866.223.8508 phone button, followed by a globe Español toggle and pipe-separated uppercase links (Visit AEP.com | Investors | Careers). The AI-built footer is a near-black navy rgb(7,25,44) block with four equal h4 columns ('Need help?' among them), lists of underlined white links and a large bold phone number.

Both footers end with small legal text that includes the copyright '© 1996-2021 American Electric Power' and a Privacy Policy link. The original's link is bold red; the AI-built page's links are underlined, beside a notice that using the site means accepting the Terms.
The original's footer has right-aligned dark-gray Twitter, Facebook and YouTube icons.
On both pages the copy is brief, informational utility-service text with imperative CTA labels such as 'Learn about incentives' and 'Track your order', and totals about 301 words.

The original stacks mostly white sections with airy gaps, separated by thin light-gray bands. Its text is left-aligned; centered text appears only in the LED block and the red footer band. The AI-built page (3452px tall) is a series of full-width bands with alternating backgrounds — navy, white, blue gradient, white, pale blue, white, navy, white, near-black — each with about 64px of padding. Centered text appears only in the alert band.
The original uses 141 ARIA attributes and a heavy list structure (61 ul, 240 li). The AI-built page uses 2 ARIA attributes, 4 ul and 15 li.

Both pages use custom, non-utility class names. The original has 1,597 class usages over 294 unique classes, a Tailwind-like fraction of 0.118 and 26 inline style attributes. The AI-built page has 58 usages over 25 unique classes, a fraction of 0 and 4 inline style attributes.
